properties.label: Rotation
properties.hint: Applied around X, then Y, then Z

properties.label: Anchor
properties.hint: Where the joint sits, from the object's center

properties.label: Connects to
properties.hint: Object it hinges on; empty means its parent

properties.label: Joint
properties.hint: Object whose joint this motor drives; empty means this object

reward_terms.label: Reach the goal
reward_terms.description: A bonus once the agent is inside the goal zone.

reward_terms.label: Progress to the goal
reward_terms.description: Reward for every metre the agent gets closer to the goal.

reward_terms.label: Face the goal
reward_terms.description: Reward for pointing toward the goal or the parking direction.

reward_terms.label: Avoid collisions
reward_terms.description: A penalty each time the agent hits something.

reward_terms.label: Be quick
reward_terms.description: A small penalty for every step taken.

reward_terms.label: Move forward
reward_terms.description: Reward for the distance the body travels forward.

reward_terms.label: Stay upright
reward_terms.description: Reward for keeping the torso up.

reward_terms.label: Save energy
reward_terms.description: A penalty proportional to motor effort.

reward_terms.label: Do not fall
reward_terms.description: A penalty when the body falls over.
